# Additional comment.
def chunk_text(text, max_len=1000, overlap=150):
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    chunks = []
    while text:
        if len(text) <= max_len:
            chunks.append(text)
            break
        cut = text.rfind(" ", max_len // 2, max_len)
        if cut < 0:
            cut = max_len
        chunks.append(text[:cut])
        text = text[max(1, cut - overlap) :].lstrip()
    return chunks
